text.tspan: Existing usable execution can be reused.
Original authority and session horizons remain fixed.
4 · Dispatch once and use admitted authority
Only the actual admitted turn continues.
Measure new-work refusal and last protected bytes within 30 seconds.
Physical stop and provider cleanup are separate outcomes.
Time flows downward. Solid arrows request. Dashed arrows reply.

Close affected sessions after committed narrowing

Cancel affected work or stop exact revision
